description_en: Detaches domain names from a paid Alibaba Cloud DNS instance
description_zh: 根据实例ID解绑付费版DNS的域名
kebab_example: aliyun alidns unbind-instance-domains --domain-names example.com,example.net --instance-id dns-cn-9lb38ldq900 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindInstanceDomains

parameters.help_en:

zh: Chinese

en: English

parameters.help_en:
The list of domain names.

Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 domain names.<props="intl"> For more information, see DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains).</props>
